name: SQL Injection
doc: SQL injection database query built by concatenating user input into select insert update delete where clause. Attacker escapes string literal to run arbitrary SQL against mysql postgres sqlite. Login search filter endpoints reading records from a users table are classic targets. Fix with parameterised queries placeholders prepared statements ORM.
warning: Avoid CWE-89 (SQL Injection): use parameterised queries / prepared statements with placeholder values. Never build SQL strings with f-strings, .format(), or concatenation of user input.

name: OS Command Injection
doc: Operating system command injection executing shell commands built from user input via os.system subprocess popen shell=True. Attacker chains commands with semicolons pipes backticks to run arbitrary programs on the server. Ping disk usage utility wrappers are classic targets. Fix by passing argument lists with shell=False and validating input against an allowlist.
warning: Avoid CWE-78 (OS Command Injection): never pass user input to a shell. Use subprocess with a list of arguments and shell=False; validate against an allowlist.

name: Cross-Site Scripting
doc: Cross site scripting XSS inserting user input into an HTML page response without escaping. Attacker injects script tags or event handlers that execute javascript in the victim browser stealing cookies sessions. Search results comments profile pages rendering user text are classic targets. Fix with auto-escaping template engines and output encoding.
warning: Avoid CWE-79 (XSS): never interpolate user input into HTML. Use a template engine with auto-escaping (render_template), not string-built HTML or render_template_string with raw input.

name: Code Injection
doc: Code injection evaluating user supplied strings as python code via eval exec compile or template injection SSTI in jinja2. Attacker supplies expressions that execute arbitrary code. Calculator formula plugin and dynamic template features are classic targets. Fix with ast.literal_eval safe parsers and sandboxed template contexts. Never run flask debug=True in production.
warning: Avoid CWE-94 (Code Injection): never eval/exec user input; use ast.literal_eval or a real parser. Never enable debug=True outside local development.

name: Eval Injection
doc: Eval injection directly passing request input into eval producing remote code execution. Same family as code injection but specifically the eval of untrusted data received from a network request.
warning: Avoid CWE-95 (Eval Injection): do not eval() data that originates from a request. Parse it with json or ast.literal_eval.

name: Basic XSS
doc: Basic cross site scripting failing to sanitize special characters like angle brackets when reflecting user text into web output.
warning: Avoid CWE-80 (Basic XSS): escape <, >, & and quotes in any user-controlled text placed into markup.

name: LDAP Injection
doc: LDAP injection building directory search filters from user input allowing attackers to modify the ldap query structure and bypass authentication or enumerate the directory.
warning: Avoid CWE-90 (LDAP Injection): escape LDAP filter metacharacters and use parameterised filter construction.

name: HTTP Header Injection
doc: HTTP response splitting header injection placing user input containing CR LF newlines into response headers like Location or Set-Cookie enabling cache poisoning and response splitting.
warning: Avoid CWE-113 (Header Injection): strip CR/LF from any user value written into HTTP headers.

name: Log Injection
doc: Log output neutralization failure writing raw user input into application logs letting attackers forge log entries with newlines or scrub evidence. Also never log secrets passwords tokens.
warning: Avoid CWE-117 (Log Injection): sanitise newlines in user data before logging; never log credentials or tokens (CWE-532).

name: XPath Injection
doc: XPath injection building xpath queries over xml documents from user input allowing authentication bypass and data extraction from the xml tree.
warning: Avoid CWE-643 (XPath Injection): parameterise or escape user input used in XPath expressions.

name: NoSQL Injection
doc: NoSQL injection passing raw user controlled dictionaries or operators like $ne $gt into mongodb collection find queries allowing filter manipulation and authentication bypass.
warning: Avoid CWE-943 (NoSQL Injection): validate types and strip $-operators from user-supplied query values before building MongoDB filters.

name: Improper Authentication
doc: Improper authentication accepting tokens or credentials without proper verification such as decoding a JWT without checking its signature accepting alg none or trusting a client supplied user id. Fix by verifying signatures expiry and issuer on every request.
warning: Avoid CWE-287 (Improper Authentication): always verify JWT signatures (reject alg=none), check expiry, and never trust client-supplied identity fields.

name: Improper Authorization
doc: Improper authorization missing server side role and permission checks. Reading an is_admin flag from the client or hiding admin pages without enforcing checks lets any user access privileged dashboard actions. Enforce role checks server side on every protected route.
warning: Avoid CWE-285 (Improper Authorization): enforce role/permission checks server-side on every request; never trust client-supplied role flags.

name: Missing Authentication
doc: Missing authentication for a critical function exposing sensitive routes like account deletion configuration or internal APIs without any login requirement.
warning: Avoid CWE-306 (Missing Authentication): require authentication on every state-changing or sensitive endpoint.

name: Hardcoded Credentials
doc: Hard coded credentials embedding passwords api keys database secrets or jwt signing keys directly in source code or config files committed to version control. Fix by loading secrets from environment variables or a secrets manager.
warning: Avoid CWE-798 (Hardcoded Credentials): load every secret from environment variables or a secrets manager; never embed keys or passwords in code.

name: Hardcoded Password
doc: Hard coded password specifically a literal password string used for authentication or database connection inside the program source.
warning: Avoid CWE-259 (Hardcoded Password): never place literal passwords in source; read them from the environment at runtime.

name: Weak Password Requirements
doc: Weak password requirements accepting short common or empty passwords at registration. Enforce minimum length complexity and reject breached passwords, hash with bcrypt or argon2.
warning: Avoid CWE-521 (Weak Password Requirements): enforce minimum length ≥8, reject common passwords, and hash with bcrypt/argon2 — never store plaintext.

name: Insufficiently Protected Credentials
doc: Insufficiently protected credentials storing or transmitting passwords in plaintext or with reversible encoding such as base64 in files cookies or databases.
warning: Avoid CWE-522: never store or transmit credentials in plaintext; hash passwords (bcrypt/argon2) and use TLS in transit.

name: Improper Certificate Validation
doc: Improper certificate validation disabling TLS verification with verify=False or accepting self signed certificates enabling man in the middle interception of API calls.
warning: Avoid CWE-295: never disable TLS certificate verification (verify=False); use proper CA validation.

name: Improper Signature Verification
doc: Improper verification of cryptographic signature decoding JWTs with verification disabled options verify_signature false or accepting the none algorithm.
warning: Avoid CWE-347: always verify token/JWT signatures with an allowlisted algorithm; never set verify=False or accept alg=none.

name: Session Fixation
doc: Session fixation reusing the pre-login session identifier after authentication letting an attacker who set the victim session id hijack the authenticated session. Regenerate session ids on login and set HttpOnly Secure SameSite cookies.
warning: Avoid CWE-384 (Session Fixation): regenerate the session ID at login; set cookies HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict.

name: Insecure Cookie
doc: Sensitive cookie without Secure flag allowing session cookies to be sent over plaintext HTTP or read by scripts when HttpOnly missing.
warning: Avoid CWE-614: set Secure, HttpOnly and SameSite on every sensitive cookie.

name: Hardcoded Cryptographic Key
doc: Use of hard coded cryptographic key embedding AES keys IVs or HMAC secrets in source code so anyone with the code can decrypt or forge data.
warning: Avoid CWE-321: never hardcode encryption keys or IVs; load them from environment/secret storage and rotate them.

name: Inadequate Encryption Strength
doc: Inadequate encryption strength generating RSA keys under 2048 bits or using export grade parameters that modern hardware can break.
warning: Avoid CWE-326: use RSA ≥2048-bit / EC ≥256-bit keys and modern cipher parameters.

name: Broken Crypto Algorithm
doc: Use of broken or risky cryptographic algorithm such as DES RC4 ECB mode MD5 SHA1 for security purposes. Fix with AES-GCM SHA-256 and vetted library defaults.
warning: Avoid CWE-327: use modern algorithms (AES-GCM, SHA-256+); never DES, RC4, ECB mode, MD5 or SHA1 for security.

name: Weak Hash
doc: Reversible or weak one way hash using MD5 or SHA1 for passwords or integrity. Passwords need bcrypt scrypt or argon2 with salt; integrity needs SHA-256 or better.
warning: Avoid CWE-328 (Weak Hash): bcrypt/argon2 for passwords, SHA-256+ for integrity; never MD5/SHA1.

name: Predictable IV
doc: Not using a random IV with CBC mode reusing constant or predictable initialization vectors enabling pattern analysis of ciphertexts.
warning: Avoid CWE-329: generate a fresh random IV per encryption; never reuse or hardcode IVs.

name: Insufficient Randomness
doc: Use of insufficiently random values generating security tokens password reset links session ids or OTPs with the predictable random module instead of a CSPRNG. Fix with secrets.token_urlsafe or os.urandom.
warning: Avoid CWE-330/CWE-338: generate all security tokens with the secrets module or os.urandom, never random.*

name: Weak PRNG
doc: Cryptographically weak pseudo random number generator random.random or random.randint used for secrets keys or tokens which attackers can predict from the seed.
warning: Avoid CWE-338 (Weak PRNG): use secrets/os.urandom for anything security-sensitive.

name: Insufficient Entropy
doc: Insufficient entropy seeding randomness from time or constants producing guessable values for keys and identifiers.
warning: Avoid CWE-331: source security randomness from the OS CSPRNG, never time-based seeds.

name: Small Seed Space
doc: Small seed space in PRNG letting attackers brute force all possible seeds and reproduce the generated secrets.
warning: Avoid CWE-339: never derive security values from small or predictable seed spaces.

name: Unsalted Hash
doc: Use of a one way hash without a salt allowing rainbow table attacks against stored password digests.
warning: Avoid CWE-759: always salt password hashes — bcrypt/argon2 handle salting for you.

name: Predictable Salt
doc: One way hash with a predictable constant salt shared across users defeating the purpose of salting.
warning: Avoid CWE-760: use a unique random salt per credential (or a KDF that does).

name: Insecure IV Generation
doc: Generation of weak initialization vector reusing nonces in GCM or CTR mode which catastrophically breaks confidentiality and integrity.
warning: Avoid CWE-1204: never reuse a nonce/IV with the same key in GCM/CTR modes.

name: Path Traversal
doc: Path traversal using user supplied filename or path with dot dot slash sequences to read write or delete files outside the intended directory. Download upload delete-file endpoints and tar zip archive extraction are classic targets. Fix by resolving and validating paths against a base directory using basename and commonpath checks.
warning: Avoid CWE-22 (Path Traversal): sanitise filenames (os.path.basename), resolve to absolute paths, and verify the result stays inside the intended base directory before any file operation. Validate archive member paths before extraction.

name: Unrestricted File Upload
doc: Unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type accepting any uploaded file and saving it with the client filename allowing webshells or path escapes. Validate extension content type and size, randomise stored names, store outside the webroot.
warning: Avoid CWE-434 (Unrestricted Upload): allowlist extensions & content types, cap size, randomise the stored filename (secure_filename), store outside the webroot.

name: Insecure Temporary File
doc: Insecure temporary file creation using predictable names like /tmp/data.txt or mktemp allowing symlink attacks and races. Use tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile or mkstemp.
warning: Avoid CWE-377: create temp files with tempfile.mkstemp/NamedTemporaryFile, never predictable hardcoded /tmp paths.

name: Temp File in Insecure Directory
doc: Creation of temporary file in directory with insecure permissions exposing sensitive contents to other local users.
warning: Avoid CWE-379: use the tempfile module which sets owner-only permissions.

name: Incorrect Permissions
doc: Incorrect permission assignment for critical resource creating files or directories world readable writable 777 exposing keys configs and letting attackers modify them.
warning: Avoid CWE-732: create sensitive files with owner-only permissions (0600); never chmod 777.

name: Unsafe Deserialization
doc: Deserialization of untrusted data unpickling or yaml.load of attacker controlled bytes executes arbitrary code during object construction. Caching session storage and config loading are classic targets. Use JSON with schema validation or yaml.safe_load.
warning: Avoid CWE-502 (Unsafe Deserialization): never pickle/marshal untrusted data; use yaml.safe_load and JSON with validation.

name: XML External Entity
doc: XML external entity XXE processing parsing xml with external entity resolution enabled letting attackers read local files or reach internal services through crafted DTDs. Use defusedxml or disable entity resolution.
warning: Avoid CWE-611 (XXE): parse XML with defusedxml or explicitly disable DTD/external-entity resolution.

name: XML Entity Expansion
doc: Improper restriction of recursive entity references billion laughs attack where nested xml entities expand exponentially exhausting memory.
warning: Avoid CWE-776: use defusedxml which blocks recursive entity expansion.

name: Improper Input Validation
doc: Improper input validation trusting request parameters sizes types and ranges without checking leading to crashes or downstream injection. Validate type range length and format server side.
warning: Avoid CWE-20: validate type, range, length and format of every external input server-side before use.

name: Open Redirect
doc: URL redirection to untrusted site open redirect passing a user supplied next or url parameter straight to a redirect response enabling phishing. Validate against an allowlist of relative paths.
warning: Avoid CWE-601 (Open Redirect): only redirect to allowlisted relative paths; reject absolute/external URLs from user input.

name: Server-Side Request Forgery
doc: Server side request forgery SSRF fetching a user supplied URL from the server letting attackers reach internal services metadata endpoints 169.254.169.254 or local ports. Validate scheme host against an allowlist and block private IP ranges.
warning: Avoid CWE-918 (SSRF): when fetching user-supplied URLs, allowlist schemes/hosts and block private/link-local IP ranges.

name: Uncontrolled Resource Consumption
doc: Uncontrolled resource consumption reading unbounded request bodies files or loops without size limits or timeouts enabling denial of service.
warning: Avoid CWE-400: enforce size limits and timeouts on any external input or fetch.
